_about: 1,2-Dichloroethane (1) + 1,4-Dioxane (2): total pressures against temperature, 274.89-354.9 K, at set liquid compositions. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 1,2-dichloroethane, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record.

source.citation: F. Amireche, F. B. Belaribi, I. Mokbel, J. Jose, Isothermal Vapor-Liquid Equilibria and Excess Gibbs Energies for Binary Mixtures of Cyclic Ethers with 1,2-Dichloroethane, J. Chem. Eng. Data 63 (2018) 1568-1577
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 14. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. No isotherm of the set has its own pure-component pressures, so the fit uses the vapour pressures of the component records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
